verdict.rationale: Bruno supports writing assertions and test suites against live responses ([bruno-docs-32]) and running them in CI via the CLI with JUnit/JSON/HTML reports ([bruno-docs-3], [bruno-docs-2], [bruno-docs-30]). Drift could therefore be caught with hand-written checks, but nothing in the evidence shows automatic validation against an API contract such as an OpenAPI schema. Missing for 10: validation of responses against an OpenAPI/JSON Schema contract, automated contract-drift detection, documentation of a contract-testing workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
